title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
**Essential Functions:**



* Translate business requirements into comprehensive functional and technical test cases.
* Execute and maintain automated test suites for API and UI testing.
* Perform manual testing as needed to ensure full feature coverage.
* Estimate, prioritize, and plan testing activities within Agile sprints.
* Apply AI\-driven test generation tools and autonomous agents to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts.
* Implement and maintain AI\-powered test agents for:
* Automated test creation
* Intelligent regression selection
* Automation script development
* Self\-healing automation scripts
* Use tools such as Selenium, WebDriver, Postman, Visual Studio, SQL Management Studio, and MongoDB.
* Work with Linux, Docker containers, and AWS services (e.g., EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, SQS, DynamoDB).
* Identify, isolate, document, and track defects through resolution.
* Generate test data to validate critical business logic.
* Troubleshoot complex issues and collaborate with developers on root\-cause analysis.
* Replicate production defects in QA environments.
* Work closely with Product Owners to meet sprint goals and deadlines.
* Participate in daily standups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Provide feedback on product quality, usability, and process improvements.
* Support deployment activities in QA and production environments using automation.



  





**Education and Experience:**



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of programming experience (Java or other languages).
* Minimum 5 years of experience in test automation and manual testing
* Exposure to AI concepts like prompt engineering or agentic AI, required
* Experience leading and guiding teams
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and concisely.
* Comfortable communicating in a multicultural work environment.
* Strong documentation skills with attention to grammar and detail.
